svg.title: Haunts modern ticker
svg.desc: Crawl ticker in both hybrids, and the proposed Rotate variant.
svg.text: The ticker in the modern themes: the user's choice, one pass, always pausable
Shown only when the user has picked Ticker (HEAD-2). A theme never switches it on. Under Reduce Motion, a screen reader or large text it becomes the still Line (HEAD-10, HEAD-11).

svg.text: Rotate shows each fact whole, for about 6 s, then cross-fades to the next.
One cycle per open, then it rests on the first fact. Pause control always visible.
Whole sentences are easier to read than crawling text [J]; still moving content,
so SC 2.2.2's pause duty and HEAD-10/11's fallbacks apply unchanged.
Crawl: slow constant speed, faded edges, one full pass per open, pause and options
controls at 44 pt, paused state remembered (HEAD-9). No 'BREAKING', dot, count,
